mission: Open Duck ROCm MJX loop mode probe
interpretation: GPU host Python loops over repeated MJX steps pass, while JAX control-flow loops using scan or fori time out. The local 7900 XTX blocker is tied to JAX/XLA control-flow lowering around repeated mjx.step.
workaround_lead: A host Python substep loop may be usable for slow local ROCm correctness eval, but not for training throughput.
safety: No robot tests, SSH, deployment, runtime behavior changes, policy changes, or training were run.
